portabilityRules.geometry: Keep reusable meshes in GLB/glTF with real-world meter scale and named pivots.
portabilityRules.textures: Keep PBR source textures separate from engine-specific materials.
portabilityRules.audio: Keep original WAV/OGG masters separate from runtime compression settings.
portabilityRules.gameData: Keep table rules, seat definitions, chip values, destinations, and tuning in JSON rather than embedding them in scene code.
portabilityRules.sceneObjects: Give persistent gameplay objects stable names so transforms can be exported and reconstructed in Unity.
portabilityRules.engineCode: Treat JavaScript/WebXR and C#/Unity behaviors as adapters around shared data rather than attempting source-to-source engine conversion.

coordinateBridge.policy: Convert handedness during import/export and verify forward-axis orientation per mesh.

android.goal: stable touch gameplay with low thermal load

desktop.goal: high visual fidelity and migration QA

migrationChecklist: Recover or create a canonical Unity project in source control.
Import owned/licensed GLB meshes and source textures.
Rebuild scene lighting and engine-specific materials in URP.
Map stable scene-object names and exported transforms into Unity prefabs.
Port gameplay adapters to C# while keeping rules and tuning data engine-neutral.
Configure OpenXR and Quest/Android build targets.
Use Unity Build Automation after Assets, Packages, and ProjectSettings are committed.
